answer_2.quote: We also evaluate the semantic similarity between the adversarial example and the original input using the cosine similarity of Universal Sentence Encoders (USE)... Our attack is able to consistently maintain a high cosine similarity to the original input (higher than 0.8)... We use BERTScore as a similarity score for evaluating text generation that captures the semantic similarity ...

answer_4.quote: We further conduct a human evaluation study of our attacks... annotators are able to detect BAE examples in 78.04% of the cases, while detecting our examples in 76.06% of the cases.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were shown two snippets of text—one clean and one adversarially corrupted—and asked to select which one was corrupted within 10 seconds.
